Class ProximityYewBerryTree

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.positions.trees.Tree
game.positions.trees.YewBerryTree
game.positions.trees.ProximityYewBerryTree
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, ItemSpawnable
public class ProximityYewBerryTree extends YewBerryTree
A mature Yew Berry Tree that drops a YewBerry if there is ANY actor on its surrounding tiles (its exits). No periodic (every-5-turn) drop.
